title: M11 current exact-zero OpenRouter route screen
scope: Unauthenticated, read-only public catalog, endpoint, ZDR, provider-directory and linked-term checks. No credentials, inference, retries, paid requests, configuration or deployment changes.

public_source_receipts.observed_via: official public page; last modified 2026-08-17; sections 3.5 and 4.2 reviewed

catalog_scan.filter: exact prompt=0 and completion=0; supported_parameters include structured_outputs and tools
catalog_scan.stealth_note: The public catalog has no stealth-model flag; the complete current catalog was screened and exposed no additional matching IDs.
catalog_scan.capability_limit: Streaming support is not exposed in the model supported_parameters field and needs an actual-interface check.

candidate_routes.retained_m1: Repeated ModelRun upstream shared-pool 429 stops (cycles 164, 168, 179, 195 and the 2026-09-25 probe); the latest bounded request had no served model or usage receipt.
Five interface cases passed, including streaming; batch-schema acceptance and scientific characterization did not pass their declared gates.
Interface cases passed, but all three scientific trials failed accuracy, contradiction-recall and scope gates.
Short JSON, tools, streaming and a later long-JSON case passed; scientific evaluation remains inconclusive.

candidate_routes.disposition: Exclude: generic router does not identify a stable provider/model or attach one set of provider terms.

privacy_and_zdr.contract_caveat: OpenRouter's directory labels ModelRun no-training and zero-retention. Linked Modular Terms §3.5 allow compiling Derivative Data based on User Generated Content and using/disclosing it for any lawful purpose; §4.2 grants rights to UGC incorporated within Derivative Data. The terms' applicability to this OpenRouter endpoint is not resolved by the provider metadata, so the directory labels are not a no-use-of-derived-data guarantee.
privacy_and_zdr.other_route_dispositions: AtlasCloud retains prompts; Liquid and NVIDIA list training and prompt retention. None of those exact-zero routes appears in the current ZDR endpoint inventory.

decision.conditional_lead: Qwen/ModelRun is the only exact-zero route with an OpenRouter ZDR/no-training directory match, but is not worth another interface request while retained upstream shared-pool 429s persist and the current endpoint reports raw status -2. Revisit only after a material availability/policy change and resolution of the linked-terms caveat.
decision.blocker: No currently available route combines exact-zero pricing, a stable provider, an acceptable ZDR/data-use screen, and retained qualification evidence. All direct OpenRouter GETs in this check returned HTTP 200; no public endpoint rate limit was observed.
decision.next: Keep M11-OPS-02b open. Continue independent static work; refresh public metadata only after a material catalog, endpoint, provider-policy or availability change. Do not retry Qwen on a timer or switch a default from metadata alone.
